title.script_alignment: IQ equality and hidden habits establish accessible wealth promise, followed by early disclaimer/subscribe. Six modules: time leverage and nurse-mother YouTube example, debt-drain pool, cash buffer, slow indexing, tax accounts and early giving. Pool metaphor gives debt payoff a concrete mechanism; buffer explains staying invested. Giving module initially claims reverse causation, then explicitly warns correlation is not causation. Ending recaps six and links secretwealth signs. Complete stored ending. Financial mechanisms are cashflow, time, tax shelter and behavioral discipline; personal mother revenue is unverified.
